name: spring-dashpot contact
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 以弹性和黏性耗能元件表征构件间作用的等效接触关系。
usage_note: 本文将系统组件连接等效为此类关系，不表明所有真实接触材料均为线性黏弹性。

complete_examples.text: Surveying this train-track-bridge coupled system, one can discover that the connection of all system components including the wheel-rail interfacial interaction can be equivalently treated as a form of spring-dashpot contact.
